Maya Patel: Quick postmortem follow-up: auth vendor throttled refreshes at ~01:12 UTC which cascaded to model-registry 502s and caused LB flapping. We sketched owners and short timelines.
Omar Ruiz: Hotfix (low risk): bump token_cache_ttl 60->300s, add jitter and per-subject dedupe/serialize. I'll push a canary.
Sarah Li: I'll own runbook + alerts. Proposed monitor: auth.refresh_concurrency > 40 for 3m and composite with modelregistry.502_rate > 3/min.
Kevin O'Connor: Vendor granted a 48h temporary throttle window. I'll request event logs and a written SLA addendum; legal loop if needed.
Ajay Singh: Canary config I'll push: `auth_client.token_cache_ttl=300; refresh_jitter_ms=200-1000; dedupe_window_ms=3000`. Adding metric `auth.refresh_dedupe_hits`.
incidents-bot: Task created: "auth-refresh-hotfix" assigned to Omar Ruiz, Sarah Li. Due in 24 hours.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for `auth-client-config` (canary=5%), CI green.
Maya Patel: Action recap: Omar hotfix (24h), Ajay metrics + revocation hook (48h), Sarah runbook/alerts (7d), Kevin vendor + legal (48-72h), EngRuntime evaluate signed-token/fallback (8w). Recheck after canary completes.
Omar Ruiz: ACK, starting canary now and will post results in-thread.
